C x.mc-feature-usage EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use collection expressions when the target type is clear; use required when initialization is part of the valid construction contract (not a substitute for constructor/domain validation); avoid deeply nested patterns; use field to remove trivial backing fields. ;; = ;; none ;; Context-sensitive language-feature technique, explicitly outside the oracle (EXC-002).
C x.mc-records-immutability EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Records suit immutable DTOs, genuine Value Objects and messages; identity/lifecycle entities normally stay classes; prefer immutability when natural but do not force it where controlled mutation is clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Record/immutability guidance outside the oracle (EXC-002).
C run009.no-mechanical-modernization OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not rewrite existing clear code (manual backing fields with logic, traditional extension methods) solely because newer syntax exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.raw-strings-not-sql OL RUN-008,SEC-004 MUST_NOT ;; Raw string literals do not make raw SQL appropriate by themselves. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.spans-default-collections OL RUN-008,RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Span/ReadOnlySpan/stackalloc/pooling are performance tools; use ordinary arrays, strings and collections by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-langversion EX DEP-008 MUST_NOT ;; Before using a language feature confirm the configured language version supports it; do not change LangVersion or the target framework to use newer syntax. ;; = ;; none ;; Prohibition on version changes for syntax is broader than DEP-008's preview/RC approval gate.
C run009.modernization-task OL RUN-009,GOV-014,WF-005 MUST ;; When explicitly asked to modernize: preserve behaviour, keep focused, prefer readability, build and test, do not mix unrelated architecture refactoring. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run009.no-newest-for-own-sake OL RUN-009,RUN-008 AVOID ;; Avoid newest syntax for its own sake, record struct merely to avoid allocations, and mass constructor conversion. ;; = ;; none ;;

C wf001.greenfield-read-owners OL WF-001 MUST ;; For greenfield work (before path rules load) explicitly read CLAUDE.md Architecture Defaults, docs/technology-stack.md, repository-structure.md, architecture.md, dependencies.md, persistence.md, and angular.md when frontend is in scope. ;; = ;; none ;;
C ps.goals OL ARC-001,DEP-024,DEP-002,ARC-027,GOV-013,WF-005 MUST ;; Scaffolding goals: explicit project boundaries via references, approved layout, approved stack, no speculative projects/abstractions/directories, a solution that builds immediately and is verified. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.scaffold-scope OL GOV-013,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Determine what the project actually needs before creating files; do not scaffold optional infrastructure because it may be useful later. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.baseline-stack OL DEP-002,DEP-011 MUST ;; Use the baseline stack; add conditional technologies (Mapster, resilience) only when actually required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.required-toplevel OL ARC-027 MUST ;; Create only the required top-level directories and repository-wide files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ps-repo-files EX DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; Repository-wide scaffold files are <Name>.slnx, global.json, .gitignore and README.md (following solution-layout.md). ;; = ;; none ;; global.json/README.md/.gitignore as standard scaffold set is not in the oracle (DEP-022 covers only .slnx).
C dep023.keep-root OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Keep the provided .editorconfig, Directory.Build.props and Directory.Packages.props at the repository root. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.create-projects OL ARC-001,DEP-024 MUST ;; Create <Name>.Domain, <Name>.Application, <Name>.Infrastructure and <Name>.Api under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.remove-duplicated-props OL DEP-023 MUST ;; Take the target framework from Directory.Build.props and remove duplicated shared properties (target framework, nullable, implicit usings) that dotnet new writes into project files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.only-described-refs OL ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Add only the references described in backend-layout.md; never add an outward reference to make compilation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.baseline-packages OL DEP-003,DEP-006 MUST ;; Add baseline packages through add-dependency with versions resolved at implementation time and recorded in Directory.Packages.props; never copy stale versions from examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.useful-test-projects OL ARC-027,DEP-013 MUST_NOT ;; Create only useful test projects; Domain.Tests only when Domain has non-trivial behaviour worth testing independently; Infrastructure.Tests only for a concrete need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ps-angular-test-placement EX DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Angular unit/component tests are colocated with the code they test; E2E tests, when used, live under the workspace (e.g. frontend/<Name>.Web/e2e/). ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend test placement convention not in the oracle.
C dep024.angular-workspace OL DEP-024,DEP-014 MUST ;; With frontend scope create the workspace under frontend/<Name>.Web/ with the current Angular CLI and the baseline stack. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.minimal-dirs OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create only directories required by the initial implementation; no empty trees for hypothetical capabilities. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.dev-config-scaffold OL DEP-026 DEFAULT ;; For SQL Server projects create the Development configuration described in backend-layout.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.no-prod-migration-automation OL WF-019,SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Production credentials or Production migration automation when scaffolding. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.scaffold-verify OL WF-005,WF-003,WF-006,WF-009 MUST ;; Before declaring scaffolding complete restore, build backend (and Angular when present), run relevant tests, inspect references with check-manifests, inspect the tree, confirm Development configuration, then run verify; never report success for a non-building solution. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.add-project-minimal OL ARC-001,ARC-027,WF-005 MUST ;; When adding a project identify its responsibility, add only minimum references preserving direction, update shared configuration when necessary, build and test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.no-split-for-show OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Do not split code into additional projects merely to make the architecture look more sophisticated. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.reorganize-steps OL GOV-014,WF-001,WF-005 MUST ;; Reorganizing: inspect tree/references, identify a concrete structural problem, preserve behaviour, move in small reviewable steps, update namespaces/references consistently, avoid unrelated feature work, verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.no-forced-template OL GOV-014,RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not force an established project to match this template when that provides no concrete value. ;; = ;; none ;;
C ps.completion OL ARC-001,DEP-002,ARC-027,WF-005,DEP-026,GOV-014 MUST ;; Project-structure completion: structure matches scope, references respect boundaries, approved stack used, no unnecessary projects/directories, builds pass, relevant tests pass, Development configuration usable, no unrelated reorganization. ;; = ;; none ;;
